Common.tagline: From idea to plate, with AI.

Home.intro: Create, cost, illustrate and manage your recipes. Free access, by invitation, during this first phase.

SignIn.title: Sign in
SignIn.intro: Enter your email address: you will receive a sign-in link valid for 15 minutes, usable once. No password.
SignIn.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a sign-in link has just been sent. Remember to check your spam folder.
SignIn.noAccount: No account yet? Access is by invitation.

errors.rate: Too many requests. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.server: The link could not be sent. Please try again shortly.

reasons.lien: This sign-in link is no longer valid (expired or already used). Request a new one.
reasons.session: Your session was closed. Please sign in again.
reasons.invitation: Account creation failed: the invitation is no longer valid. Contact the person who invited you.

Verify.title: Confirm sign-in
Verify.intro: Click the button to complete your sign-in.
Verify.invalid: This link is incomplete. Request a new sign-in link.

Invitation.title: Create my account
Invitation.codeIntro: Enter the personal code you received with your invitation.
Invitation.intro: Your invitation is valid. Enter your email address: you will receive a link to activate your account.
Invitation.emailLocked: This invitation is reserved for this address.
Invitation.name: Your name (optional)
Invitation.sent: Almost done: an activation link has been sent to {email}. It is valid for 15 minutes.

problems.invalid: This invitation code does not exist. Please check it.
problems.revoked: This invitation code has been disabled.
problems.used: This invitation code has already been used.
problems.wrong_email: This invitation is reserved for another email address.
problems.rate: Too many attempts. Please try again later.

errors.consent: You must accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.
errors.account_exists: An account already exists with this address: please sign in.
errors.server: Sign-up could not be completed. Please try again shortly.

Suspended.title: Access suspended
Suspended.body: Access to this account has been suspended. Your data is kept. For any question, contact the person who invited you.

TwoFactor.title: Two-step verification
TwoFactor.enrollIntro: Administration requires a second factor. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Microsoft Authenticator…), then enter the 6-digit code shown.
TwoFactor.verifyIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a backup code.
TwoFactor.backupIntro: Keep these codes somewhere safe: each one lets you sign in if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.

errors.locked: Too many errors: entry is blocked for 15 minutes.
errors.not_enrolled: The second factor is not set up.

App.regenerations: Plus up to {count} text regenerations per recipe.

Security.title: Security
Security.intro: Devices currently signed in to your account.
Security.signOutEverywhereHint: Closes every session, including this one.

Legal.missing: This document will be published soon.

Wizard.title: Create a recipe

questions.precision: Narrow down the region, country or cuisine
questions.mode: How do you want to create?

inputQuestion.name: Which recipe do you want to make?

inputPlaceholder.ingredients:
One ingredient per line, with the available quantity if you know it.
e.g. 400 g salmon
1 lime
rice
inputPlaceholder.name: e.g. Beef bourguignon, pad thai, lemon meringue pie…
inputPlaceholder.idea: e.g. an autumn dessert with pear and buckwheat, served warm.

Wizard.precisionHint: Optional: you can stop at the region or the country. Up to 3 cuisines for a fusion.
Wizard.search: Search a cuisine or a country…
Wizard.traditionalDisabled: A fusion cannot be presented as traditional.

idea.title: From an idea
idea.hint: A craving, a mood, a constraint

Wizard.generatingHint: This usually takes less than a minute. You can leave the page: the recipe will be waiting for you.
Wizard.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {No recipes left this month} one {# recipe left this month} other {# recipes left this month}}

errors.quota: You have used your {limit} recipes this month. The counter resets on {date}.
errors.quotaRegen: You have used the {limit} regenerations of this recipe.
errors.budget: Generations are paused until next month (monthly budget reached).
errors.incomplete: Some information is missing: go back to the previous steps.
errors.not_found: Draft not found: please reload the page.
errors.invalid_output: The proposed recipe was not valid. Your quota was not used: please try again.
errors.refusal: This request could not be processed. Rephrase your input (your quota was not used).
errors.truncated: The recipe was too long and got cut off. Try again (your quota was not used).
errors.provider_error: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly (your quota was not used).
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Your quota was not used: please try again.
errors.start_failed: Something went wrong. Your quota was not used: please try again.

Wizard.savedBody: It is saved in “My recipes” and will stay there, even if you close this page.
Wizard.regenerateHint: Optional: what you want to change (e.g. “lighter”, “no oven”)
Wizard.regenerateRemaining: {count, plural, =0 {No regenerations left} one {# regeneration left} other {# regenerations left}}
Wizard.imageSoon: The recipe photo is coming soon.
Wizard.noSocial: Social media content could not be generated for this recipe.

Recipe.costSoon: The cost will be calculated once ingredient prices are filled in.

Recipe.costTotal: Food cost ({count, plural, one {# serving} other {# servings}})

Ingredients.title: My ingredients
Ingredients.intro: Enter what you pay for your ingredients: the cost of every recipe that uses them is recalculated automatically. Prices are per kilo, per litre or per piece, depending on the ingredient.
Ingredients.empty: Your ingredients will appear here after your first recipe.
Ingredients.toConfirmHint: Added automatically during a generation: check its name, then confirm it.
Ingredients.invalid: Invalid price: enter a positive number, for example 9.80.
Ingredients.estimateFailed: The estimate couldn't be completed. Try again in a moment.
Ingredients.estimateBudget: This month's AI budget is used up: price estimates are paused until next month.
Ingredients.proposalsHint: {count, plural, one {# price estimated by AI, to check.} other {# prices estimated by AI, to check.}} Adjust them if needed, then save them one by one or all at once.
Ingredients.validateAll: Approve {count, plural, one {the estimated price} other {the # estimated prices}}

Pricing.title: Selling price and margins
Pricing.subtitle: Per portion · recipe for {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}. Amounts update as you type.
Pricing.needPrices: Enter your ingredient prices first: the suggested price and margins are based on the food cost.
Pricing.incomplete: {count, plural, one {# ingredient has} other {# ingredients have}} no price yet: the cost is underestimated.
Pricing.actualEmpty: Enter your selling price (incl. VAT) below to see your actual margins.
Pricing.coefficientHint: Price excl. VAT = food cost × multiplier (often between 3 and 4).
Pricing.sellingPrice: Selling price per portion, incl. VAT (€)
Pricing.sellingPriceHint: Optional: the price on your menu.
Pricing.laborHint: For the whole recipe ({count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}), prefilled with the preparation time.
Pricing.energyTitle: Appliance usage time (minutes, for the whole recipe)
Pricing.disclaimer: A decision aid: the final price is up to you.

invalid.coefficient: The multiplier must be a number between 0.1 and 50.
invalid.sellingPrice: The selling price must be a positive amount, e.g. 14.90.
invalid.labor: Working time must be a number of minutes (24 h at most).
invalid.energy: Usage times must be numbers of minutes (24 h at most).

Settings.title: Costing settings
Settings.intro: These values are used to compute the cost and suggested price of all your recipes. You can adjust them recipe by recipe.
Settings.coefficientHint: Price excl. VAT = food cost × multiplier (often between 3 and 4).
Settings.hourlyRateHint: Fully loaded cost of one working hour. Leave empty to ignore labour.
Settings.kwhPriceHint: Shown on your electricity bill (about €0.25). Leave empty to ignore energy.

invalid.coefficient: The multiplier must be a number between 0.1 and 50.
invalid.hourlyRate: The hourly rate must be an amount in euros, e.g. 20 or 22.50.
invalid.kwhPrice: The kWh price must be an amount in euros, e.g. 0.25.

Settings.appliancesIntro: Each appliance's power is used to compute a recipe's energy cost.
Settings.applianceInvalid: Enter a name and a power in watts (between 1 and 30,000).

Bases.title: My bases
Bases.intro: Your homemade preparations (breads, doughs, stocks, condiments…). They come from the “Make it homemade” button next to a store-bought ingredient, and their cost replaces the store-bought price.
Bases.empty: No bases yet. In a recipe, click “Make it homemade” next to a store-bought ingredient.
